decisions.reason: As the remaining two-component injection unit after Product A was withdrawn, it now serves that customer segment alone and likely meets aspirations, though its niche results stay somewhat uncertain.
Automatic airless guns are a core accessory that supports pump and system sales, so there is no performance gap that would trigger problemistic search.
Manual airless guns are a staple item with steady replacement demand that ties customers to the firm's equipment, so results likely meet aspirations.
The multi-model air-assisted line serves established industrial finishing customers, and individual models can be adjusted without dropping the whole line.
The data logger's results remain the most uncertain, but it fits the firm's push toward digital monitoring and documentation, and slack allows it to be carried longer.
